data.description: Polished range input. Adds a value badge that follows the thumb, optional min/max footer, and a `--aed-range-pct` CSS variable for fill styling.

data-aed-range-prefix.description: String prepended to the badge value (e.g. '$').

data-aed-range-suffix.description: String appended to the badge value (e.g. '%', ' hrs').

data-aed-range-decimals.description: Decimal places shown in the badge.

data-aed-range-foot.description: Render a small min/max footer beneath the slider.
